scripts.build: python3 scripts/bootstrap_build_python.py && .build-venv/bin/python scripts/validate_futures_compass.py && .build-venv/bin/python scripts/validate_dashboard_batches.py && .build-venv/bin/python scripts/generate_public_dashboard_payloads.py && .build-venv/bin/python scripts/generate_data_catalog.py && .build-venv/bin/python scripts/validate_public_data_contracts.py && PUBLIC_JS_ASSET_VERSION=${PUBLIC_JS_ASSET_VERSION:-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || date +%s)} astro build && node scripts/inject_public_js_version.mjs dist
